Close Close Worldwide Free Shipping Available from Singapore Close About us At Nook Nordic we strive to make everyday living more enjoyable by sharing the best designs from Scandinavia with the rest of the world. We carefully select products that give us a warm and cozy feeling in our own homes. That's what we call "hygge" in our home country of Denmark, where most of the designers we work with are also from. Most of our products are handmade and we emphasize natural materials such as wood, because they possess a cozy animated feeling that sleek designs in metal just can't replicate. It is this emphasis on animated designs, natural materials, and the finish only hand-crafted products have that enable a true emotional connection between our customers and products. We know it sounds silly, but we promise that you will instantly understand when you unbox your gift, whether that gift is for yourself or that special someone.
